scope.purpose: Individual substantive reuse decision for four unchanged D050 KEEP/KEEP pairs; no new blind round and no progress registration.

method: Read both original D records and each complete current P profile, including expectations, coverage, variation axes, application cases, retained dissent and authority.

Read current bilingual canonical targets and relevant prerequisites/successors. Compare actual current own context with the sealed D050 input using buildGoalDescriptionCanonicalContext; own titles/descriptions and context remain equal for all four.

Load the current national-atlas inputs natively, retaining actual compiled applicability, duration model and course profile. Compare old/new page bodies only after removing book-coordinate fields and normalizing internal/external references by goalId/title. All four normalized page comparisons have no differences.

Inspect direct source mappings, precise official source-extraction clauses and the local official Hessen PDF Q4.6, printed page 47. This receipt does not claim a new full 16-state source-coverage audit or convert partial mappings into exact mappings.

Run collectCompositionProjectionRoleGoalIds for authored views to check the declared direct prerequisites. Use only the 64 current national source-manifest paths for the omission finding; additional national fallback views are not counted here.
Read the backend direct-requirement behavior to distinguish an intentionally hidden prerequisiteOnly node from an omitted direct prerequisite. No backend or runtime edit was made.
Visually inspect the three existing bound images. Preserve their bytes and publication status; the no-image case retains its existing deliberate deferral.

bindingRules.wholeFileDigests: Snapshot evidence only; concurrent unrelated changes to the shared canonical/registry do not assert changed content for these four. Recheck per-goal bindings before materialization.
bindingRules.normalizedPageComparison: Remove pageNumber/navigationOrder/treeOrder/pageFingerprint; combine internal/external prerequisite and successor references as sorted goalId/title pairs. No authored text, scope, image or relation content is discarded.
bindingRules.oldReviewsRemain: Original D050 records, independent run IDs, evidence claims and all historical artifacts remain unchanged. This receipt is informed synthesis, never a replacement blind opinion.
bindingRules.approvalBoundary: All four P records remain positive-understanding-evidence-v2, needs_human_review, ai_candidate, E1/G1. No human or publication approval is inferred from reuse.

sourceEvidence.excludedSiblingClause: Retrograde loops, history of orbital models and worldviews remain with 44766569/6d18104b.

sourceEvidence.supportedClause: Describe the apparent motions of the Sun, Moon and planets in the sky; this is partial visibility support, not a loops/history mandate.

substantiveAdjudication.reason: The sole needed Solar-System prerequisite supplies roles and orbital ordering, enough to establish observer position, inner/outer orbit and sightlines. Its widened raw cache neither changes this geometry nor imports Kepler timing, tides or stellar physics. A heliocentric angle is not an observed elongation; the P core requires constructing the Earth-centred sightlines and explaining morning/evening or night visibility.
substantiveAdjudication.bothReviewContribution: A explicitly demands translating heliocentric position to the Earth observer and rules out unsupported historical content. B tests the inner-versus-outer planet distinction and opposition; these are complementary evidence for the same narrow representation competence, not two copies of a hash judgment.
substantiveAdjudication.profileCheck: Two independent demonstrations remain required. The inner-planet case forces a fresh observer construction and a visibility explanation. The outer-planet opposition-to-conjunction transfer changes geometry and viewing time, predicts first and then checks. Drawings/simulations remain admissible canonical alternatives; use the source-specific simulation-to-drawing sequence when teaching the BY source clause, without imposing it on all national contexts.
substantiveAdjudication.physicalCounterexample: An inner planet cannot reach opposition as viewed from Earth; a body near solar conjunction is poorly separated from the Sun and is not an all-night object. This must be explained from geometry rather than memorized labels. Exact horizon times are not required without latitude/date information.
substantiveAdjudication.imageDecision: Retain the explicit provider-limitation deferral: independent construction is assessed; no nonexistent illustration is approved.

sourceEvidence.mappingBoundary: The reviewed 1:n mapping deliberately separates this classification child from d2e source evaluation and af5 basic roles. No mastery of the qualitative af5 child substitutes for researched multi-criterion evidence.

Criteria combine orbital role, dynamical environment and physical data; provisional classification is required when decisive data are absent. The raw-cache change to af5 does not add the separate source competence. However, a declared and substantively justified prerequisite d2e is omitted from the actual target views listed above.
substantiveAdjudication.bothReviewContribution: A tests a round Sun-orbiting object without orbital dominance and rejects eccentricity-only classification. B tests a round body orbiting a planet and rejects roundness-only classification. Both support the existing text and multi-criterion image, but neither substitutes for resolving the newly identified missing projected prerequisite.
substantiveAdjudication.profileCheck: The two P cases require independent classification and a fresh incomplete-data transfer, not name recognition or copying the chart. Selecting and assessing source-backed information is a genuine part of the current canonical route, supported by the separate d2e prerequisite; the hold concerns route availability, not a need to rewrite these satisfactory P examples.
substantiveAdjudication.imageDecision: KEEP the existing multi-criterion chart and existing review evidence. The little orbit drawing is schematic; eccentricity is dimensionless, not a length to measure on the illustration. No new image generation or image approval.

sourceEvidence.supportedClause: Set up radiation equilibria, estimate temperatures, reflect assumptions and use the temperatures as a starting point for assessing conditions for life.
Planetary radiation balance, Stefan-Boltzmann radiation, inverse-square flux, energy-budget comparison and habitable-zone assessment.
sourceEvidence.excludedSiblingClause: Solar internal structure and separate exoplanet/habitability competences are not absorbed just because the HH rows are mapped 1:n.

substantiveAdjudication.reason: The goal is one model-to-bounded-inference chain. af5 supplies a body/orbit context; 89124b92 supplies thermal-radiation temperature estimation. Neither prerequisite requires an HRD-radius sibling to be mastered. The current direct roles support both. The new radius illustration is outside this target input and cannot invalidate the unchanged balance diagram or the correct independent balance work.
substantiveAdjudication.bothReviewContribution: A isolates absorbed versus emitted power and distinguishes equilibrium from real surface temperature. B changes albedo/atmosphere while keeping the external radiation situation comparable and requires a limited habitability inference. Both retain, rather than erase, model assumptions and pressure/environment limitations.
substantiveAdjudication.profileCheck: Case 1 supplies luminosity, distance, albedo and redistribution assumptions and requires predicting changes, setting up the balance, computing with units and distinguishing modeled from actual temperature. Case 2 changes atmosphere/internal heat/observations at the same estimated equilibrium temperature and requires a justified model critique. Emissivity must be stated as an assumption or given; a blackbody example uses epsilon=1. This is already within the modeling expectation, not an extra compulsory parameter-estimation goal.
substantiveAdjudication.physicalCounterexample: For an airless, evenly radiating spherical body with isotropic stellar luminosity L: (1-A)L/(4*pi*d^2)*pi*R^2 = 4*pi*R^2*epsilon*sigma*T^4, so T=[(1-A)L/(16*pi*epsilon*sigma*d^2)]^(1/4). Radius cancels, T is in kelvin, increasing albedo reduces T and increasing distance reduces T. A matching T is not evidence of actual liquid water or life.
substantiveAdjudication.imageDecision: Retain the existing absorbed-pi-R-squared versus emitted-four-pi-R-squared balance and atmosphere contrast. The plotted warmer surface is the illustrated greenhouse case, not a universal climate prediction.

substantiveAdjudication.reason: c52 remains a qualitative observational foundation: redshift and background support the hot-Big-Bang model. aa0 supplies the next data-to-model step using given simple relations, not a repeat of c52 or a general cosmology survey. The current c52 cache enlargement does not make advanced calculations part of that prerequisite. Current aa0 scope is entirely SekII, and required model equations may be supplied.
substantiveAdjudication.bothReviewContribution: A requires identifying the same spectral line, computing the dimensionless shift and explaining the chosen model. B independently checks why high z or important peculiar motion invalidates an unchanged low-z conversion while leaving the measured wavelength ratio valid. The two opinions support the same limited relation, not generic cosmic-history recall.
substantiveAdjudication.profileCheck: Both independent P demonstrations and fresh transfer remain: 500 nm to 510 nm gives z=0.02 and, only with the given low-z model, H0=70 km/s/Mpc and negligible peculiar motion, d≈85.7 Mpc. The second 400 nm to 800 nm case gives z=1 and a_now/a_emit=2 from the supplied scale-factor relation; low-z Hubble distance inference is not licensed. No derivation of cosmological field equations, age reconstruction or dark-energy evidence is required.
substantiveAdjudication.physicalCounterexample: Redshift is dimensionless. Distance is model-inferred rather than directly read from the spectrum. In the high-z transfer, blindly carrying over the linear low-z relation is the wrong inference; the learner must name the failed approximation.
substantiveAdjudication.imageDecision: Retain the unchanged broad cosmology illustration as supporting context, especially its explicit small-z and negligible-peculiar-motion qualification. Background, structure formation and standard-candle panels do not expand this atomic goal or its mastery requirements.
